title: Seattle Nautic Fishing & Boating Charter
specs: Fishing for salmon, lingcod, flounder, and Dungeness crab
Boat departs from Shilshole Bay Marina, 20 minutes from downtown Seattle
Captain Thao teaches beginners; steady action on flounder and lingcod trips
Dungeness crab season and rules strictly followed; captain assists with sexing and measuring crab
Washington fishing licence required for all fishing guests; one-day licences can be issued onboard
Crabbing requires fishing licence, Puget Sound Crab Endorsement, and catch record card
Captain Thao is USCG-certified; safety decisions made by captain
Boat capacity 6 guests per trip; up to 12 guests per day with back-to-back trips
Private charters only; no shared trips

services.name: Squid Fishing
services.desc: Open year-round, steady bites, and the single best charter for kids and first-timers on Puget Sound. If you want a rod that actually bends, start here. Nobody dreams about flounder. People dream about a thirty-pound Chinook. But here is the thing every guide knows and few will say out loud: a salmon trip can be a long, quiet, cold day of not very much. That is fishing. It is a wonderful day if you are an angler and a genuinely miserable one if you are eight years old. Flounder bite. That is their virtue. blurb: Guests fish for salmon, lingcod, flounder, or crab on a private 21' Grady-White boat with a USCG-certified captain. Trips range from 3 to 6 hours and include all gear, bait, and life vests. The boat departs from Shilshole Bay Marina about 20 minutes from downtown Seattle.
